dict.string: Murmur listens only while you hold its keys, and understands you on this Mac.
Murmur's assistant controls apps when you ask it to: your browser's tabs, music, reminders and dark mode.
Murmur's assistant reads your calendar when you ask what's coming up. It stays on this Mac.
